name: Replicated State Vocabulary
description: Define the vocabulary of replicated state: document, operation, log entry, snapshot, conflict, merge. Establish the core domain language used across all sync subsystems.
purpose: Establish a shared domain vocabulary for replicated state that all sync subsystems reference, ensuring consistent terminology and mental models across the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: All core terms (document, operation, log entry, snapshot, conflict, merge) are defined in a shared vocabulary document or module.
Each term has a clear type definition, relationship diagram, and usage example.
Vocabulary is the single source of truth — no duplicated or contradictory definitions across sync subsystems.
